title: SEC-R2: round-2 summary — 3 of 4 fixes correct
description:
Security review round 2 of fixes c3z.2, c3z.4, c3z.6, c3z.8.

c3z.2 PASS: Sieve admin start_sieve_admin_server matches transit check_admin_config exactly. is_loopback_addr is a verbatim copy (IPv6 bracket handling, localhost fallback). All four branches correct. Test coverage complete.

c3z.4 PASS: Sentinel cache cleared by all three mutation endpoints (put_script line 251, delete_script line 271, activate_script line 292). Each clears only on success. Tests at lines 675, 700, 727 cover all three.

c3z.6 PASS: node_id validation checks len != 16 then hex::decode; a 16-char non-hex string correctly returns ConfigError::Validation. Both checks required and present.

c3z.8 PARTIAL: core_pool is passed to build_stats_json where it is used only for SELECT COUNT(*) FROM msgid_map — read-only, correct. However the /log-tip endpoint (build_log_tip_json) is called with transit_pool (line 264) and queries a 'group_log' table that does not exist in either migration set. Filed as stoa-c4a48573.2.
